Na maioria dos projetos, WordPress com W: In most projects, WordPress with WooCommerce: no platform subscription, a familiar dashboard and many available integrations. Operations with very specific rules may call for a custom solution, defined during discovery.
As taxas de pagamento e frete estão incl: Are payment and shipping fees included?
Não. Taxas do gateway, frete, hospedagem: No. Gateway fees, shipping, hosting and ERP are contracted in your company's name and paid directly to the providers. The project price covers development and setup.
A entrega inclui o cadastro inicial e o: Delivery includes the initial product setup and training so your team can carry on. Large catalogs can be imported via spreadsheet, priced by volume.
